waiver.disclosed_in: ZHanry/home-tunnel-client v10.0.0 release notes (docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md) and the hub 10.0.0 release notes
waiver.reason: A Web viewer controlled a Windows 10.0.0 host through the production 10.0.0 server over direct UDP and the TURN relay on development builds of the same feature code; that run is not re-executed on these final bytes. The isolated native video/input acceptance harness was not run on the final signed worker.
